title: AAPS Dev/Debug - LeakCanary results
symptom: LeakCanary reports memory leaks and OutOfMemoryError's during heap analysis while running AAPS dev/debug builds. The user reports leaks occurring when changing Automations and continuously updating leak results.
cause: The thread does not establish a definitive root cause. MilosKozak's analysis shows unreachable objects related to Equil pairing fragments, but the user questions how Equil gets involved as it was not active.
fix: No fix is stated in the thread. The maintainer says reports are welcome but not necessary to hunt for them specifically.
